slides.texte_overlay:
detachment lessons that shifted
my entire mindset

believe their actions

i learned to trust what people do, not what they say. actions always tell you more than words, and that one lesson saved me from so much quiet disappointment.

not everything stays

some people and moments are only meant to pass through your life. letting them go gently, with gratitude, is so much lighter than trying to hold on tight.

protect your mind

i stopped letting noise and drama fill my head, and i started feeding it something good instead: a myth, a planet, a painting. my thoughts finally became my own.
slides.texte_sophia:
protect your mind

i protect my mind from noise now. i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, a myth or a planet, and my own thoughts finally feel calm and clear again.

slides.texte_overlay:
you can't control their view

you can't control how people see you. once i accepted that, i stopped performing for others and started living in a way that actually felt like me again.

guard your energy

your attention is far more valuable than you think. spend it on people and things that give you something back, and quietly and calmly walk away from the rest.
